description.value: Ono Poké is a Victoria-based Hawaiian poke bowl chain with four shopping-centre locations across the city and Saanich. Founded after the owner's transformative first taste of poke in Hawaii, the restaurant prepares traditional Hawaiian poke and BBQ layered with fresh West Coast ingredients. Cyclists will find a range of customizable bowls — including vegan, gluten-free, and high-protein options — plus Hawaiian hot plates and snacks like spam musubi.
